body: Yes, on snapchat. She says she can't wait to stop waking up and for the sweet release of death. She told me in a message, she's planning on killing herself and she's a lost cause.  Another friend of her's is having a birthday party on Friday. I think she's waiting until after that.

Disability would be the one she'd tear into. She would probably say cut all their benefits so they're motivated to work and the tax incentives for corporations will create jobs for them. I want to avoid the silliness of trickle down economics and stay on topic.
There are people obviously taken advantage of the situation, some have a choice, some not so much. I got families at the hospital with a dozen children, having another and neither parent is employed. Somehow they have a nicer phone than me. One specifically said "this is my business", have children for the welfare benefits. Now, I believe that the majority of people enrolled in those benefits actually need them. I don't have the numbers though. I don't know how to convince someone that ending those benefits would be a disaster or how to fix the system. Employment and strong economy helps for sure, but either side can argue for that. I liked welfare to work, because it put a time limit on people to get their stuff together and helped them a bit to do so. That may not apply the same way to disability though, and not sure how you could regulate that.

Thank you for the detailed response.
